commands.description: Displays the current configuration running in RAM on the Cisco device.
commands.sample_output:
router-01# show running-config
Building configuration...

Current configuration : 3124 bytes
!
version 15.2
service timestamps debug datetime msec
service timestamps log datetime msec
!
hostname router-01
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 description WAN
 ip address 192.0.2.2 255.255.255.252
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description LAN
 ip address 10.10.10.1 255.255.255.0
 no shutdown
!
router ospf 1
 network 10.10.10.0 0.0.0.255 area 0
!
line vty 0 4
 transport input ssh
!
end

commands.description: Displays the configuration saved in NVRAM that will be loaded after a reboot.
commands.sample_output:
router-01# show startup-config
Using 3190 out of 65536 bytes
!
version 15.2
!
hostname router-01
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 ip address 192.0.2.2 255.255.255.252
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 ip address 10.10.10.1 255.255.255.0
!
end

commands.description: Provides a quick summary of interfaces, their IP addresses, and status.
commands.sample_output:
router-01# show ip interface brief
Interface              IP-Address      OK? Method Status                Protocol
GigabitEthernet0/0     192.0.2.2       YES manual up                    up
GigabitEthernet0/1     10.10.10.1      YES manual up                    up
Loopback0              10.255.255.1    YES manual up                    up
GigabitEthernet0/2     unassigned      YES unset  administratively down down

commands.description: Displays the IP routing table of the router.
commands.sample_output:
router-01# show ip route
Codes: C - connected, S - static, O - OSPF, D - EIGRP, B - BGP, R - RIP
Gateway of last resort is 192.0.2.1 to network 0.0.0.0

C    10.10.10.0/24 is directly connected, GigabitEthernet0/1
L    10.10.10.1/32 is directly connected, GigabitEthernet0/1
C    192.0.2.0/30 is directly connected, GigabitEthernet0/0
L    192.0.2.2/32 is directly connected, GigabitEthernet0/0
O    10.20.0.0/16 [110/20] via 10.10.10.2, 00:02:10, GigabitEthernet0/1
S*   0.0.0.0/0 [1/0] via 192.0.2.1

commands.description: Displays the ARP table (IP-to-MAC address mappings).
commands.sample_output:
router-01# show ip arp
Protocol  Address          Age (min)  Hardware Addr   Type   Interface
Internet  10.10.10.2              5   aabb.cc00.0102  ARPA   GigabitEthernet0/1
Internet  192.0.2.1               2   0015.5d00.1234  ARPA   GigabitEthernet0/0
Internet  10.10.10.1              -   0011.2233.4456  ARPA   GigabitEthernet0/1

1    default                          active    Gi0/1, Gi0/2
10   SALES                            active    Gi0/3, Gi0/4
20   ENGINEERING                      active    Gi0/5
100  MANAGEMENT                       active
